entities.name: Inverse identification of Barlat models is difficult because they have many parameters and require highly informative data; furthermore, applying the framework
entities.description: Inverse identification of Barlat models is difficult because they have many parameters and require highly informative data; furthermore, applying the framework to real experimental DIC data remains necessary because practical measurements introduce noise, imperfect boundary conditions, incomplete observations, and possible model discrepancy that can undermine optimization robustness and parameter uniqueness.
entities.evidence_span: Inverse identification of Barlat models is challenging because these models contain many parameters and require highly informative experimental data.

evidence_spans: Inverse identification of Barlat models is challenging because these models contain many parameters and require highly informative experimental data.

Future work will focus on applying the framework to real experimental DIC data for inverse parameter identification. Experimental measurements introduce noise, imperfect boundary conditions, incomplete observations, and possible model discrepancy, which can affect optimization robustness and parameter uniqueness.
